scope: Shared managed admission of PDF mesh sample hash-table storage
implementation: Use pinned hashbrown 0.16.1 with the existing Fx hasher. Before each table growth reserve a conservative bound including buckets, control bytes and alignment. Keep old and new reservations concurrently during rehashing. Check allocation_size against the admitted bound after growth. Retain the final reservation alongside the table and drop table storage before its credit.
verified: Every observed table growth independently refuses and releases all retained credit.
Successful table storage remains covered by credit until the returned map drops.
Real authored tensor decode succeeds at exact observed shared peak; one byte less refuses during map growth and releases all credit.
All 61 previously recorded source-page pixels or refusals remain unchanged.
limitations: Table admission is conservative rather than an exact process allocator cap.
SmallVec color components above four require separate heap accounting.
Patch visibility inventory, source parser objects and other renderer allocations remain unaccounted.
Broader runtime performance qualification after table admission is still pending.
